Because no categories were requested, this ranking selects the three knives that best satisfy the full weighted criteria across the general-purpose mainstream of the class, drawing most heavily on Serious Eats' controlled multi-knife testing (the most rigorous supplied source) supplemented by The Kitchn's hands-on review. A curator may want to request 'budget' and 'carbon steel/Damascus' as separate categories given how differently they perform against the weights above."
